data.description: The figure is a BHA (Bottom Hole Assembly) graphical report for well ID Forge 56-32, located in the UTAHFORGE field. The BHA consists of various components including HWDP (Heavy Weight Drill Pipe), DC (Drill Collar), SH/SUB (Stabilizer/Sub), MONEL (Monel), STAB (Stabilizer), XO (X-Over), MMTR (Motor), and the BIT itself, all arranged in a specific order. The report provides details such as the length of each component in feet and inches, top thread specifications, serial numbers, and their respective positions from the top to the bit.
